final.summary: Tank level stayed within 0.30 to 0.48 of volume and fell steadily, showing water was held and then passed through the ETP. ETP inflow averaged 64.2 m3/h with no replay, and outfall pH stayed 7.31 to 7.86, well below the 9 threshold for raw wastewater. result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
